findings.claim: Expedia 10-K FY2025 風險因子指出 AI、雲端、替代平台與行動裝置的成長及擅用新技術的利基競爭者，已經且將持續需要新的昂貴投資，轉型可能干擾資源與服務並提高對第三方服務商的依賴。
findings.excerpt: AI, cloud computing, the continued growth of alternative platforms and mobile computing devices, the emergence of niche competitors who may be better able to utilize existing and new technologies to optimize their products, services or strategies have, and will continue to require, new and costly investments.

findings.claim: Expedia 在 ChatGPT 與 Claude 有訂房整合，並將 emerging AI-powered platforms 列為競爭威脅；OpenAI 縮減 ChatGPT 直接結帳；Expedia 自家調查僅 8% 旅客願意透過 AI 平台訂購。
findings.source: GeekWire：Expedia Group sees reward and risk in the rise of AI-powered travel

note: 搜尋摘要（GeekWire/Fast Company 等）提到 ChatGPT/Claude 整合、OpenAI 縮減直接結帳、Expedia 自家調查 AI 信任落差 8%，但未取得可逐字原文，故未列入 findings。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
